name: untitled2-v1
why: A Fusion 360 recreation of both bodies, held to Fusion's own measurements: each is a revolve of the export's clamped uniform degree-5 B-spline pole rows, and the cup's two rim edges are filleted at 5 mm. Exact B-rep (this script's STEP, probed): Body1 36359.856 mm3 / 7027.379 mm2 against Fusion's 36356.903 / 7025.506 (+0.008% / +0.027%); Body2 126698.727 mm3 / 26405.298 mm2 against 126698.252 / 26405.273 (+0.0004% / +0.0001%); both bounding boxes the same. The export's own B-rep reads 36420.013 and 126430.918, off Fusion's figures by more than this recreation is. The recorded numbers are the runner's mesh-measured ones. The drop stands clear inside the cup, 19.296 mm at the closest.
